LanguageData.EF_AI_Enabled_Tip: Raiders, visitors, animals and mechs decide for themselves when to use the abilities their gear gives them, and your own pawns use the abilities you set to autocast. Off: nobody does.
LanguageData.EF_AI_Hostiles_Tip: Raiders and anyone else hostile to your colony.
LanguageData.EF_AI_NonHostiles_Tip: Visitors, traders, caravan guards and allied soldiers.
LanguageData.EF_AI_Animals_Tip: Any animal, your tamed ones included.
LanguageData.EF_AI_Mechs_Tip: Any mechanoid, your own included while they aren't drafted.
LanguageData.EF_AI_Who_Desc: Your colonists, slaves and drafted pawns only use abilities you set to autocast. Prisoners never use any.
LanguageData.EF_AI_Unclaimed: Also use abilities that don't come from entads
LanguageData.EF_AI_Unclaimed_Tip: Lets the same decision making cast a pawn's own abilities when they are set up for it, such as a raider psycaster's psycasts (most combat psycasts from Royalty are). Off: only abilities from entad gear.
LanguageData.EF_AI_Approach: Walk into range to use an ability
LanguageData.EF_AI_Approach_Tip: A ranged pawn in a fight walks a few tiles closer when a target for one of its abilities is just out of range or out of sight, uses it, and then fights as usual. Only for abilities set up for it, such as flashbang and battle cry. Never while badly hurt, fleeing or held in melee.
LanguageData.EF_AI_PlayerAutocast_Tip: Right-click an ability button to choose whether your pawn uses it by itself. Only for abilities the AI knows how to use, and for now only while the pawn is drafted: it casts while it stands in position or shoots, never in the middle of a move you ordered.
LanguageData.EF_AI_BreakCasting: Your colonists use abilities during mental breaks
LanguageData.EF_AI_BreakCasting_Tip: A colonist in a mental break is out of your control, so your autocast choices don't apply. With this on, a colonist in an aggressive break (berserk and the like) uses its abilities the way a raider would, treating your other colonists as enemies, and a panicking one may use movement abilities to flee. Off: colonists in a break use no abilities. Animals and mechs follow their own settings above.
LanguageData.EF_AI_MinGap: Least time between one pawn's casts: {0} s
LanguageData.EF_AI_MinGap_Desc: Stops a pawn with several abilities from using them all in the same moment. Each ability's own cooldown and charges still apply.
LanguageData.EF_AI_DebugLog_Tip: Writes a line to the log each time a pawn decides to cast something, naming the rule it used.
